title: Inflation Attitudes of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multivariate regression analysis of simulated inflation survey responses using demographic dummy variables (such as income, housing tenure, age, social class, education, and region) to evaluate model outputs against human survey baselines and official statistics.

Sensitivity analysis and Shapley value decomposition to measure the model's oversensitivity to highly visible macroeconomic price signals (e.g., food and energy prices) compared to their actual consumer basket weights.
